writeScope: Only this new audit artifact; no canonical, source, mapping, composition, review, resolution, registry or runtime mutation.

scope.subject: Physik
scope.excluded: Mathematik, new blind D reviews, broad re-review of unchanged curricula, runtime/image QA acceptance, full atlas/applicability builds and M6 reruns.

comparisonCommits.currentComparisonTarget: Working-tree files, not an assertion that the complete dirty worktree equals HEAD.
comparisonCommits.checkpointLimit: e347b6e5b is later than the original review captures; since-checkpoint equality does not reconstruct earlier source bytes.

methods.canonicalComparison: Complete JSON goal objects for exactly nine IDs compared against git show at the canonical baseline; all equal.
methods.historicalTextComparison: DE/EN title and description compared with each listed historical round-a input; all equal. Historical reviewer judgments were not replaced or re-reviewed.
methods.nativeContextComparison: Read-only invocation of buildGoalDescriptionCanonicalContext from app/scripts/validateGoalDescriptionReviewCampaign.ts and stableGoalBookJson from app/scripts/goalBookModel.ts; all nine differ only in applicability. Sorting jurisdiction makes exactly the two order-only cases context-equal. This is diagnostic comparison, not a native resolution validation pass.
methods.immediateNeighborComparison: Direct prerequisites plus reverse-requires and containing parents compared for title, titleEn, description, descriptionEn, requires, contains, applicability and extendedData against the canonical baseline; no differences found. Image bytes/resourceLinks were not re-reviewed by this context audit.
methods.sourceComparison: All bytes of the exact 11 directly matching mapping files and 10 referenced extraction files compared against the canonical baseline. Affected mapping rows and rationales inspected as retained evidence, not newly approved.
methods.sourceContentInspection: Targeted existing sourceText/rawSourceText entries read from HE and BY extractions for the cited nine cases, together with existing mapping rationales and prior audit/receipt boundaries. No fresh full original-PDF or all-curricula review and no web search.
methods.compositionComparison: Static targeted comparison of goalEntry/canonicalSubtree anchors and projectionRole for these nine goals across 69 current Physik JSON view files, expanding contains only to identify matching anchors. Anchor/role multisets equal the canonical baseline for all nine; three goals are structurally relocated in the two HE SekII views. All 69 view files are byte-equal to the recorded B050-audit commit. This is not a fresh native compiled-target or runtime rendering check.

historicalCacheEvent.claimAuthority: Retained 2026-09-08 receipt; not newly rerun in this audit.
historicalCacheEvent.interpretation: The seven larger jurisdiction caches do not establish new normative state obligations or newly introduced compiled target sets. limits: An applicability cache is not a normative curriculum requirement, a source-coverage approval or proof that the goal is a target in every listed state.

Seven set expansions are real serialized canonical-context deltas, but the retained cache-event receipt documents zero compiled applicability-set changes. No new target sets were compiled or authored here.

Native exact-context equality remains strict. The order-normalized diagnostic for two goals is not authorization to edit sealed inputs, bypass validators or restore description completion automatically.

Byte equality preserves existing evidence bindings; it does not newly approve the fachliche correctness or completeness of every historical mapping or extraction. Generic historic rationales and partial mappings were not promoted to full source approval.

Whole Physik view files changed after e347b6e5b; the no-change finding concerns these nine authored anchors/roles. Current full view files equal the later recorded audit commit. Structural placement changes in HE are recorded separately.
No claim that current full-atlas page fingerprints equal historic batch-local fingerprints. The prior B050 audit records historical reverseRequires drift for the solar-system case.
Round-a inputs were used as historical binding snapshots; this audit is not another independent reviewer and does not supersede any retained A/B judgment.
No image, runtime, learner-host, M6 or source-release acceptance is conferred. Parent-owned checks and subsequent B057 decisions remain separate.
Conclusions describe the inspected working-tree snapshot at checkedAt and should be refreshed if any bound semantic/context/source/mapping input changes.
